subject.title: fix: microphone input menu collapses to a sliver in the chat composer

question: Should maintainers close this protected conflicting PR as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101377, or ask for a rebase only if a unique current-main microphone-selection gap remains?
rationale: The evidence supports a superseded cleanup, but the `maintainer` label blocks automatic closure and the branch is not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR because merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101377 removed the old composer popover and keeps microphone selection usable in Chat settings.

options.title: Request A Rebase
options.body: Ask for a current-main rebase only if maintainers identify a unique microphone-selection behavior that the settings-owned implementation still misses.

options.title: Revive The Composer Popover
options.body: Reopen the old composer-caret direction intentionally, accepting that it reverses the current settings-owned design from the merged follow-up.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR because merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101377 removed the old composer popover and keeps microphone selection usable in Chat settings.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the original microphone-selector feature and this follow-up patch, and is the best observed owner for deciding whether any unique current-main behavior remains.
